info.name: Audiowaveform Preview Provider
info.summary: Creates waveform previews of audio files
info.description:
Have previews for your audio files.
This preview provider creates previews of audio files in waveforms, created out of the audio content. This app needs a local copy of [audiowaveform](https://github.com/bbc/audiowaveform), an open source library by the BBC.
Supported formats: **flac**, **ogg**, **opus**, **mp3**, **wav**
info.author: Blizzz
